title: Coating thickness
intro: Ten painted steel panels, coating thickness in micrometers (µm). The point estimates: x̄ = 50.70 µm estimates the mean μ of every panel the line paints; s² = 1.3556 µm² (dividing by n − 1) is the unbiased estimate of σ², while the population variance 1.2200 (dividing by n) is biased low; the standard error s/√n = 0.3682 µm is the typical distance between x̄ and μ.
